idea: Auto-notify the crew LEAD when a member crashes, via the existing system-mailbox + armed-listener channel (no polling). crews has crash DETECTION (hooks/health.js getMemberHealth -> 'dead') but it is pull-only; the gap is a sweep that joins detection to delivery (appendSystemMailbox) plus a dedup latch, with a trigger that fires while the lead is idle. Includes the key scope decision: hard-crash-only vs also a stalled/idle (9h-dark, pid-alive+heartbeat-fresh+lastTurnAt-frozen) case.

candidateDirections.name: Heartbeat-tick liveness monitor in the lead listener
candidateDirections.summary: Throttled sweep on the lead listener's existing heartbeat setInterval (the only periodic hook in an indefinite timeoutMs===null listener) — the ONLY mechanism that wakes a quiet idle lead; on a high-confidence dead transition append a member-crashed system envelope to the lead mailbox before consume/exit. Cost: O(members) FS reads per throttled tick; honestly a daemon-internal monitor, not lead-model polling.

candidateDirections.name: Dying-gasp self-report + sweep backstop
candidateDirections.summary: Member's own listener/launcher best-effort emits a member-crashed envelope on UNEXPECTED exit (Node process.on exit/uncaughtException; PowerShell launcher on non-clean engine exit) for near-zero latency on graceful crashes; a slower sweep backstops hard kills. Risk: handlers do NOT fire on taskkill/T, OS crash, power loss, or the UNKNOWN/-4094 lock-bug class that motivated the task.

candidateDirections.name: Lead-model turn-boundary hook sweep
candidateDirections.summary: Run the health-transition sweep at the lead's PreToolUse/Stop/SessionStart boundaries where roster + state-cwd context is natural and the listener hot path is untouched; also the natural home for latch-reset hygiene. But it CANNOT wake an idle lead during a quiet crash (waits for the lead's next turn) — a backstop/latch-reset layer, not a standalone solution.

questionsForSynthesis: Is the product requirement IMMEDIATE quiet-period crash notification (requires the D-001 periodic monitor / accept a background timer), or is surfacing crash state at the lead's next wake acceptable (D-003 suffices, simpler)?
Is the 'always listeners, never poll' rule absolute even for DAEMON INTERNALS, or is a throttled in-listener monitor an acceptable carve-out (daemon monitoring, not lead-model polling)?

Dedup latch home + exact generation key {memberName, sessionId, launcherPid, launcherStartedAt, deadReason} and the precise reset wiring in resume-crew repair + clear-member cleanup — dead member's manifest (races repairManifestForResume under the manifest lock) vs a lead/crew-level liveness-notifications/incidents file?
member-crashed: review-required AND strict-ack-exempt like member-left, or force the lead to explicitly ack the crash notice?

SCOPE DECISION: defer the 9h-dark stalled case to a separate member-needs-attention / auto-nudge feature (RECOMMENDED — high false-positive risk, healthy-idle looks identical), or in-scope behind a default-off threshold? Note hard-crash-only does NOT solve the 9h-dark class that partly motivated this.
Operator visibility: lead-only core with operator escalation as a phase-2 config knob (RECOMMENDED), or operator always paged on hard-dead?
v1 acceptance criterion: exactly one review-required lead notification per high-confidence alive->dead incarnation transition, and zero notifications for quiet/unknown members?
